host_reciprocal_analysis.input_range: All 8388608 FP32 mantissas in [1,2), representing positive normal [1,8192] by exact powers-of-two scaling; unfused arithmetic

source_policy.baseline: Original vector QK/PV arithmetic, scalar exponentials/global maxima, and scalar per-output division. Reference arithmetic was not slowed or weakened to create gains.
source_policy.editable_arithmetic: Normalization and global-max bodies were extracted unchanged into the candidate region. Dispatch, causal local maxima/masks, KV appends, PE budget, collective calls and full-sequence timers remain frozen. Every reported pair uses the same new baseline/evaluator identities.
source_policy.precision: All candidate arithmetic remains FP32. Four Newton reciprocal iterations use the stable-softmax denominator invariant [1, context] and a host-checked [1,8192] range. The fixed 1e-4+1e-4*abs(expected) output requirement and bit-exact cache check are unchanged.
source_policy.sharding: The 16/32-PE latency profiles use identical global quantized inputs and context-128 work to the original 4-PE profile. The 5.103x ratio compares two 32-PE programs; it does not count added PEs as an optimization.

earlier_milestone.source_track: Earlier baseline with normalization hook, before the global-max hook; historical record is unchanged. Gains across profiles are not multiplied.

qualification_scope.other_final_source_profiles: Pending screen/full qualification at report creation; no cross-shape >5x claim.
